source: Written in the layout of the exchange's announcement summaries (attchmntText) for order-win filings; not copied from filings (the exchange's archive can't be read from here). Company names are used as the summaries name buyers.

docs.text: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange that it has received an order worth Rs 450 crore from Bharat Electronics Limited for supply of radar subsystems.

Rail Vikas Nigam Limited has informed the Exchange that RVNL has received Letter of Acceptance from South Central Railway for upgradation of traction system. The value of the project is Rs. 187.34 crores.
Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has signed a contract with the Ministry of Defence (MoD) for procurement of 97 LCA Mk1A aircraft.
KEC International Limited has informed the Exchange that it has secured new orders of Rs. 1,047 crores across its various businesses.
NCC Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has emerged as L1 bidder for a project of National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) worth Rs 2,100 crore.
Kalpataru Projects International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding receipt of orders from a leading global OEM in the Middle East.
Hindustan Construction Company Limited has informed the Exchange that the contract awarded by Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation has been terminated by the client.
Ashoka Buildcon Limited has informed the Exchange regarding an order passed by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal in the matter of a subsidiary.
BEML Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has bagged an order from Bharat Coking Coal Limited for supply of 24 dumpers worth Rs. 230 crores.
Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange that it has received orders from Power Grid Corporation of India Limited and NTPC Limited aggregating Rs 1,190 crore.
expect: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited

docs.text: Siemens Limited has informed the Exchange that it has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with Indian Railways for joint development of signalling systems.
Bharat Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding receipt of orders worth Rs. 572 crores.
Simplex Structures Limited has informed the Exchange that it has received a work order from Tata for structural steel works worth Rs 86 crore.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company is in discussions with Indian Railways for an order of wagons and expects to receive the order shortly.
Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has signed a contract with the Indian Navy for construction of five fleet support ships.
Kernex Microsystems (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding receipt of Letter of Award from M/s. Larsen & Toubro Limited for supply of Kavach equipment worth Rs 112 crore.
